result_preview.title: Product Cost and Complexity Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregated metrics on product cost drivers, BOM complexity, and supplier impact analysis.
result_preview.description: This analytical data product delivers aggregated cost and complexity metrics across product portfolios, integrating bill of materials depth, material sourcing patterns, and engineering change frequency. It enables procurement and engineering teams to identify high-cost drivers, optimize supplier qualification strategies, and track compliance documentation effectiveness across the product lifecycle.
useCases: Manufacturing optimizes production sequences based on identified complexity drivers.
Finance teams benchmark actual product costs against target cost models.
Finance and product teams understand cost implications and design complexity to inform pricing and production planning.
Product managers evaluate cost implications of design decisions before procurement.

result_preview.title: Material Cost and Invoice Reconciliation Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates material consumption and supplier invoicing data to optimize procurement ROI.
result_preview.description: This dataProduct synthesizes Material entity consumption patterns with Invoice records to provide comprehensive financial analytics on procurement efficiency. It summarizes cost variances, supplier performance metrics, and material usage trends to support customer monetization strategies and campaign ROI optimization. The analytics enable identification of cost reduction opportunities and invoice accuracy validation across production operations.

result_preview.title: Bill of Materials Cost and Compliance Analytics
result_preview.shortDescription: Aggregates material costs, supplier impact, and compliance metrics across engineering changes.
result_preview.description: Synthesizes engineering change records, material master data, and product item configurations to aggregate supply chain costs, bill of materials complexity, and regulatory compliance exposure. Provides metrics on supplier dependencies, cost variance trends, and compliance risk implications for product portfolio decisions in sales planning.
useCases: Compliance teams verify BOMs meet regulatory material restrictions before manufacturing.
Finance validates BOMs against approved cost budgets for product variants.
